name: openrouter-models
description: OpenRouter — one key for hundreds of models across providers. Chat (with image input), embedding, image generation, and video generation from a single instance. Bring your own OpenRouter API key.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: OpenRouter API Key
x-meta.help: Your OpenRouter API key (openrouter.ai/keys). Leave empty to fall back to the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

x-meta.label: Default Model
x-meta.help: An OpenRouter model id (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5). Empty = resolved from live /v1/models discovery.

x-meta.label: Base URL
x-meta.help: Optional override of the OpenRouter base URL. Empty uses https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
